latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of image-highlight-cropper skill.
- Automatically extracts and crops the 5 most visually interesting square regions from user-uploaded images.
- Ensures one highlight is always on a visible painter's signature, centered and uncut.
- All crops are square, well-composed, and saved as downloadable files; handles edge crops with white background if needed.
- Presents cropped highlights in chat (2 per row), each with a label and short explanation.
- Invites users to request different highlighted areas or crop sizes.
